source_full_text: He was furious at this new trick which he felt had been played on him by Maria, and was still looking at them, wondering how he should pay her out, When he was told that the merchant, Maria's father, had finished the business on which he had been sent and returned home. Then the king remembered how Maria had refused to receive his visit, And how she had stolen his fruit, and he determined to be revenged on her.
